text: Earth... still up there. Alright — we start again. If anyone survived, I will find them.
Commander, there's an order to things. We have to meet someone first — we can't move on without them.
Scattered blades, once gathered, become a formation. Let us plan our next move, Commander.
The Turtle Ship? Four hundred years old, rebuilt with today's materials... oh, this is going to be fun.
My — what poor manners for a guest. The toll for this sector belongs to my company. Pay... or be liquidated.
